name: Huntsman: Protect & Serve
summary: Huntsman: Protect & Serve is a DLC where you discover a hidden section of Atherton Labs teeming with ravenous creatures. Unlike the base game's evasion gameplay, you're armed and must stand your ground against multiple threats. Combat requires strategic ammunition management, careful reload timing, and awareness that gunshots attract more creatures. Puzzle-solving is essential to escape the facility's depths.
